# Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - April 17, 2026

> 日期: 2026-04-17 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2026/04

## Balance Hotfix Update

This is a balance hotfix update. Replay codes from the April 14, 2026 patch are still available.

## Damage（输出）

### Sierra（输出）

*开发者注：Sierra has not been as effective as intended since her launch. Her weapon damage is being increased to improve overall output, while the damage increase to Tracking Shot better rewards players for successfully landing it. The Anchor Drone changes improve mobility responsiveness and drone survivability, allowing for more aggressive playstyles. Sierra’s ultimate cost has also been increased due to its already fast charge rate in combination with her improved damage output.*

#### Trailblazer
- Ultimate cost increased by 30%.

#### Helix Rifle
- Damage per projectile increased from 7 to 9.

#### Tracking Shot
- Damage per projectile increased from 7 to 9.

#### Anchor Drone
- Health increased from 30 to 80.
- Grapple move speed increased from 20 to 22.

#### Medi-Drone – Major Perk
- Healing increased from 75 to 100.
